title: Medicine Ball Slam
summary: An overhead throw that slams a ball into the ground, for power and conditioning.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: medicine ball or slam ball.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.4 for lats (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.4 for abs (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.2 for front delts: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.2 for triceps: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Raise the ball overhead, on your toes.
Slam it down in front of you, hinging and bracing.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up, then repeat.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Similar muscles; bodyweight instead of medicine ball.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, Less stable, Less systemic fatigue.
